C1251.title: Five Staten Island Residents Charged in a Million-Dollar Apple Gift Card Fraud Scheme
C1251.summary: In October 2021, the Richmond County District Attorney's Office announced the arrest and arraignment of five Staten Island residents. Prosecutors said the group used previously stolen American Express account information between July and September 2021 to obtain gift cards and purchase Apple products. Searches recovered about $787,000 in unused Apple gift cards, $118,000 in cash, and multiple unopened products.
